exposure: Prophylactic temporary balloon occlusion of the anterior division of the internal iliac arteries (hypogastric arteries)
cohort: 44 patients diagnosed with placenta previa/accreta/percreta, with 32 undergoing prophylactic balloon occlusion and 12 undergoing cesarean section without intervention
finding: Patients who underwent prophylactic balloon occlusion experienced significantly less estimated blood loss during surgery compared to those who did not undergo the procedure.
